critical_code_review_comments: services/mlb_statcast.py — Clean, documented, thresholds (min 80 PA / 60 BF) prevent small-sample noise. `_is_hitter_market` / `_is_pitcher_market` correctly exclude team-level markets, spreads, moneylines, NRFI/YRFI, and pure Over/Under/Yes/No selections. Enrichment uses a per-slate cache to avoid duplicate DB reads. `find_one` projections correctly exclude `_id` — MongoDB ObjectId safety respected.

services/mlb_umpire.py — Pragmatic hardcoded seed table (documented rationale: no free JSON API for umpire K% deltas; ~0.60 season-over-season correlation makes this durable). Correctly classifies at ±1.3pp threshold. Handles 'D.J.' vs 'DJ' via period-stripped fallback lookup. HTTP call to MLB Stats API boxscore for plate umpire is defensive (try/except → None). Deduped game_pk cache is O(distinct_games) not O(picks). One nit: `if not mlb_k_picks: return 0` is checked before allocating the httpx client — good.

signal_engine/calculators.py — mlb_deep_signal now correctly returns neutral when `mlb_deep` AND both statcast dicts are absent. When mlb_deep is None but statcast_batter is present, it still fires the xBA/xwOBA/barrel% signals without touching park factors — no KeyError on missing `park_hr_factor`. Budget MLB_DEEP_MAX correctly bumped from ±5 to ±7 to accommodate stacked signals. `_clamp` on the final points keeps output within budget.

volume_signal correctly gates the umpire signal on `market_l contains 'strikeouts'` and `ump_zone in ('hitter','pitcher')`, so unknown/neutral zones don't fire. Magnitude clamped at ±1.8 within the ±7 volume budget.

pick_enrichment.py + picks_routes.py wiring — both creation-time (pick_enrichment) and read-time (/api/picks/today) enrichment paths call enrich_picks_with_statcast_bulk + enrich_picks_with_umpire_bulk. Belt-and-braces design covers picks created before the ingester was deployed.
server.py — 24h refresh loop scheduled from startup. Confirmed via DB check (422 batters + 486 pitchers for year=2026).
